notes.title: Patch 2.2 28/04
notes.notes:
Here are the notes:

- Mining asteroids now has a chance of giving you a little fuel
- Changed the way pause buttons work
- Ensured that all achievements are getable
- Ensured that all planets are reachable and beatable
- Changed the percentage of the saves to represent achievements only
- Fixed ??? game ship issue

I also wanna say that this might be the last patch before getting out of Early Access
Thanks so much for everyone who helped reporting bugs; You guys are awesome!

notes.title: Patch 2.1 28/04
notes.notes:
Here are the 2.1 patch notes:

- Changed minion achievements to be easier to get
- Made minion only give item help on less than 4 health/armor
- Minion now cancels giving item if you're too far away
- Items now stop on "cloud" platforms
- There is now a delay for boosting on space
- Boosting no longer happens while mining in space
- Boosting now lasts a little longer and costs 10 Fuel
- Fixed lava smoke sound looping endlessly
- Fixed music sometimes would load wrongly
- Fixed golden chest achievements (for real this time)
- Fixed impossible puzzles on ??? game
- Fixed desert boss on ??? game

Also, if you have the soundtrack DLC there's now a button on the menu screen that opens the folder to the soundtrack files

notes.title: Patch 2.0 notes 26/04 [New Stuff!]
notes.notes:
Patch 2.0 is out! Added new stuff and fixed some others.
Here are the notes:

Fixes:
- Fixed wine achievement bug
- Fixed issue with "girl indication" icon
- Fixed issue where Windowed mode wouldn't load properly
- Fixed random freezes on ????
- Fixed golden chest achievements

Changes:
- Changed final death achievement to be 25 times
- Changed final gold achievement to be 500 gold
- Changed a few "Mr Sellers" locations to enhance progression
- Getting items that goes to second page no longer switches it when closed
- Map items now have limited sales for each "Mr Seller"
- Space background is now "prettier"
- There are no longer loading screens

Aditions:
- Added ability to change the window size manually
- Added space ship "turbospeed" (press Buttons)
- Clicking twice on inventory items now stack all items

notes.title: Patch 1.2 25/04 (Controller Bug Fixed)
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
So, tired of configuring your joystick each time you get in the game? Problem fixed!
So here are the notes:

- Fixed bug where joystick information wouldn't save/load properly
- Fixed bug where joystick would crash game
- Fixed bug where keyboard wouldn't work because of joystick
- Fixed issue where joystick wouldn't get recognized at boot

If you notice any of these things to not work as i said, feel free to post in the discussion forums and i'll look into it
Cheers!

notes.title: Patch 1.1 - 24/04
notes.notes:
So the controller+keyboard patch is out, here are the notes:
- Integration with keyboard and joystick at the same time
- Joystick is now a single cloud save, no longer different for each slot
- Fixed bug where you could multiply items when dead
- Fixed bug with "cockroaches" on toxic planets
- Re-did slots and save logic for faster and better saves

[b]IMPORTANT NOTES!
If you are using a controller, i suggest you load all your slot saves by clicking the "+" button several times and restarting the game - this will allow for your controller information to be reset and saved as one[/b]

I will close down the Controller Issue post i made on the forums and cross this out of the list

Cheers guys!
